info.title: MorphieCore HTTP API
info.description: HTTP API summary for the local gateway, not full vendor API conformance. Generation uses a typed IR, stateless upstream history and bounded pre-publication failover. Responses enables gateway-managed TTL history by default; store:false opts out. Known fields are strict; unknown generation fields are ignored, not forwarded. Standalone tasks require explicit activation. Embeddings accepts text with float/Base64 delivery; other media remain frozen. Codecs define exact admission; docs/usage.md explains setup.

get.summary: Inspect partial gateway contracts for activated Generation and Embedding clients
get.description: Startup-immutable, authenticated discovery with no request-body or upstream I/O. Unlisted cases are not assessed. Claims describe individual gateway boundaries, not complete exchange success or Provider-effective support. HEAD returns headers without a body.

200.description: Complete snapshot within min(response_bytes, 256 KiB); oversized snapshots fail startup, never truncate.

get.description: Activated public labels, sorted and deduplicated. No upstream discovery or pagination. HEAD returns the same headers without a body.

200.description: Complete standard model list, bounded at startup; never a truncated successful prefix.
The same model object as in the list; no Provider or account information.

delete.summary: Reject deletion without fine-tuned model ownership
delete.description: No deletion capability. Activated labels return 403; unknown or inactive labels return 404. No local or upstream mutation.

post.description: Uses the public model's configured candidate array, shared by all Generation client protocols; candidates need not use a native Messages upstream. Handler errors use Anthropic envelopes; ingress auth errors use the shared OpenAI envelope.

post.summary: Embed an ordered text batch through an explicitly activated fixed target

200.description: Complete float or Base64 vectors and reported usage after validated EOF. Fixed activated target, no fallback. Invalid indices, effective dimensions or incomplete batches fail.

post.summary: Generate an ordered inline image collection using the static GPT Image profile

200.description: Complete inline images after validated EOF. The count must match the request; short or invalid collections fail. Explicit activation and a single-source, non-fallback pool are required.

post.summary: Transcribe one bounded WAV/MP3 upload through an explicitly activated binding

200.description: Complete text and reported duration usage after validated EOF. Native ancillary reports stay in the IR and are omitted by a named JSON projection.

post.summary: Generate bounded binary audio through an explicitly activated Speech binding

200.description: Bounded nonempty audio after validated EOF, not low-latency streaming. MIME comes from the admitted report. Native ancillary reports stay in the IR; no invented usage or transcript.

post.summary: Generate with full history or gateway-managed Responses

get.summary: Retrieve a fully delivered local snapshot as JSON
get.description: No upstream call. Unknown, expired, deleted and unstored IDs share response_not_found. Retrieval does not extend TTL. No stream resumption; unknown query fields are rejected.

200.description: Final stored snapshot, also for responses created with SSE.

delete.summary: Delete one local snapshot without invalidating stored descendants

get.summary: List resolved input, including predecessor history but excluding current output
get.description: Cursor pagination over one immutable snapshot. Unknown cursors and duplicate or unsupported query fields are rejected.

200.description: Bounded page of input items with stable cursor IDs.

PossibleAdaptation.description: Conservative notice on Generation JSON/SSE and successful Embedding responses, including pre-frame Responses failure streams. Not an actual-loss receipt or a success assertion. Missing on pre-response errors and discovery/history operations; absence does not certify exactness.

CapabilityLink.description: Gateway contract discovery, not a per-exchange receipt.

ResponseId.name: response_id
ResponseId.description: Gateway-issued ID of a stored response. Not an upstream reference or conversation-affinity key.

ConversationId.name: X-MorphieCore-Conversation-Id
ConversationId.description: Logical conversation ID, stable across turns and model changes. Duplicate headers are rejected. Without it, ingress checks X-Session-Id, session_id, session-id, then x-session-affinity. It groups routing/cache affinity, not authorization or stored history. Optional prefix cache reuse is independent.

bearerAuth.description: Configured ingress token. Use exactly one Bearer header or one x-api-key header, never both.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: The same ingress token, not an upstream key. Duplicates and simultaneous Bearer auth are rejected.

CapabilityCase.description: Treatment of this feature/domain only, assuming other validation succeeds. Request lists selected public-admission cases. Delivery rules apply equally to JSON/SSE. History preserves the delivered projection, not pre-projection facts or cross-target replay.

EmbeddingRequest.description: Text or homogeneous token-ID inputs; token inputs require a published trusted tokenizer contract and are forwarded without retokenization. Aggregate text is bounded to 256 KiB UTF-8 and token inputs to 60000 IDs; target/runtime limits may be tighter. Float or padded Base64 little-endian finite binary32 delivery is available for every activated model. HTTP omission defaults to float; SDK omission may send Base64. Output budgets use effective defaults. Named float-to-binary32 rounding rejects overflow and nonzero-to-zero underflow. Unsupported user hints may be omitted with a declared adaptation.

EmbeddingResponse.description: Vector order and complete input association are preserved. Compatible profiles use the bound public model only when upstream model identity is absent, derive counters only from reported input-only accounting, and omit usage when no usable aggregate exists. Omitted usage is an explicit departure from strict OpenAI response schemas, never zero or free service. Malformed present reports, incomplete transport, invalid vectors or dimensions still fail. Adaptation capabilities are advertised separately.

embedding.description: Runtime validates canonical padding, four-byte alignment, finite values and expected dimensions. Base64-to-float widens binary32 to binary64 before round-trip JSON formatting.

created.description: Developer publication time in Unix seconds. Date-only sources use UTC midnight; not a router listing or Gateway startup timestamp.

owned_by.description: Model developer name, not inference Provider or account owner.

shutdown_date.description: Optional standard report; omitted when unreported, not fabricated.

file.description: One nonempty WAV/MP3 upload, at most 1 MiB. Filename and MIME do not prove valid audio. No URL, file ID or local-path resolution.

language.description: Language intent; the selected target must support the code. Not copied into a detected-language report.

TranscriptionRequest.description: Multipart, not JSON. Each field occurs at most once. Upload ceiling: 1 MiB plus 16 KiB framing; operator limits may be smaller. No local persistence or audio decoding.

text.description: Complete recognized text, additionally bounded to 1 MiB UTF-8 bytes. Empty text does not itself imply a failure.

seconds.description: Reported processed audio duration; not inferred from word timestamps or locally measured file metadata.

voice.description: Named voice, additionally limited to 128 UTF-8 bytes and the target's explicit allowlist. Custom voice ID objects are not admitted.

SpeechRequest.description: Bounded binary Speech profile. Fields are non-nullable; target voice/format/control admission is separate. Input and instructions also have 16384-byte bounds. PCM is signed 16-bit little-endian, 24 kHz mono. No SSE or injected token cap.

n.description: Required delivered count; absent/null means one. A short upstream result fails without supplemental requests.

ImageGenerationRequest.description: Static inline-image profile. Absent, null and explicit controls remain distinct. Compression needs JPEG/WebP; transparency cannot use JPEG. Target admission is separate. Explicit activation is required.

ImagePixelSize.description: Canonical WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, each dimension 1..65536. Target-specific admitted dimensions may be narrower.

ImageUsage.description: Reported unsigned counts; totals and breakdowns must agree. Missing usage is not invented. A named accounting projection may omit an unrepresentable report while retaining it in the IR; strict routes reject it.

data.description: Ordered artifacts, exactly matching effective n. Decoded aggregate ceiling: 8 MiB; gateway default: 2 MiB, independent of n.

b64_json.description: Strict Base64 with nonempty decoded bytes, at most 8 MiB. Gateway/endpoint limits may be tighter. Representation checks do not decode pixels.

ImageGenerationResponse.description: Optional reports preserve absent/null/value and apply uniformly to the collection. Usage belongs to the operation. Image JSON ceiling: 16 MiB; per-image and aggregate decoded limits default to 2 MiB. No URL fetch or private carrier.

PublicModelLabel.description: Case-sensitive activated public label, without a Provider prefix. Resolves a trusted route; matching an upstream model name does not grant upstream selection.

metadata.description: Opaque end-user attribution, not credentials, routing or a cache key. Absent/null/empty user_id retain their meaning; unknown metadata names are ignored by name. Selected cross-protocol projection uses OpenAI safety_identifier or generateContent's fixed safety label, subject to stricter target bounds, without legacy user/cache substitution.

MessagesRequest.description: Envelope subset. The client codec carries text, thinking, redacted_thinking, tool_use and tool_result blocks, tools, reasoning controls and top-level output_config (effort and a json_schema format). Instruction content is text-only; system messages can additionally carry tool_addition/tool_removal blocks and per-message output_config.effort. A non-null per-message effort rejects on other roles. Adaptive thinking supports thinking.block_binding. Media-bearing instructions and non-null clear_at reject. The reviewed Go/Haiku profile opens owner-local cache, caller-selected top-level automatic cache_control (ephemeral with 5m/default or 1h ttl), ordered object input_examples in root/by-value tool definitions, per-use document context, strict tools, ordered instructions and tool changes only on all-native opted-in configured routes; mixed routes remain closed for these features. Context retains absent/null/empty/text without prompt concatenation. Examples are structurally bounded, not locally schema-instance validated. Native strict tools and JSON output share subset/resource checks: unsupported constraints, references, regex and case-sensitive string enum/const reject rather than being simplified. The reviewed numeric-schema structured/required/named profile is not arbitrary-schema or parallel-call acceptance. Cache marker bounds and TTL conflicts remain strict; write/read reports do not prove retention or invoices. Exact beta carriers and named target projections remain separate from public admission. top_k decodes into the IR and target projection decides representability. Known values stay strict; stop_sequences have a codec carrier but default binding admission remains narrower. Active container, mcp_servers, context_management and compaction are rejected; other unknown fields are ignored by name. Return thinking signatures and redacted thinking data unchanged. Codec support does not certify Provider-effective behavior.

safety_identifier.description: Independent opaque safety attribution. On single-carrier cross-protocol targets it takes priority over user; explicit null blocks fallback. Target bounds still apply; no normalization or credential/conversation-derived value.

user.description: Legacy attribution and cache-bucketing field, independent of safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key. Native OpenAI paths preserve it. Cross-protocol attribution fallback does not preserve legacy cache bucketing; its loss is recorded separately.

prompt_cache_key.description: Cache-grouping intent, separate from conversation identity. Null is not filled from conversation context; no value guarantees a cache hit.

messages.description: Ordered history. System/developer instructions are text-only and keep their position; media-bearing instructions and participant names reject at decoding. Assistant history may mix text and refusal parts. Text and selected user image/audio inputs require codec and target admission. Tool results retain call links. Unbound audio IDs and unsupported media are rejected.

tools.description: Function and custom definitions use their official nested shells. Custom inputs stay raw strings; grammar is not evaluated by the gateway. Binding and streaming admission remain separate.

tool_choice.description: Named custom choice uses custom.name; allowed_tools nests mode and typed references. The owning codec validates names and membership.

modalities.description: Output intent; audio also requires matching options and explicit public/endpoint admission. This schema activates no audio model.

audio.description: Named-voice output options. Requires audio modality; streaming requires pcm16. Target admission is separate.

max_completion_tokens.description: Client-owned output cap; omission or null supplies no cap at Chat intake. Bootstrap imposes no global default or token ceiling. A Messages target fills absence only from its trusted configured default_output_tokens, recording messages.default-max-tokens.v1; without a default it rejects locally. The Go/Haiku binding declares 32000, independently of model maxima. Explicit caps remain unchanged. Local resource limits alone do not bound upstream charges.

max_tokens.description: Deprecated spelling of the same output cap; cannot be combined with max_completion_tokens.

verbosity.description: Output verbosity has Chat/Responses codec carriers; native Messages/Google projections use selected recorded omission rules. Model-effective support and binding admission remain separate.

preserve_thinking.description: Registered historical reasoning-reading intent, independently preserving omission, true and false. DashScope carries it natively; targets without a selected carrier reject. Does not select a Provider, infer a model default or enable thinking.

enable_thinking.description: Explicit current-turn activation in the existing reasoning IR. No effort or token default is inferred. Bailian has a native carrier; other targets need their own exact representation.

thinking_budget.description: Existing reasoning allocation, not an independent answer ceiling. Cannot be combined with qualitative effort, disabled activation or a smaller total output cap. Bailian carrier support is model-specific; no token/effort conversion.

top_k.description: Registered positive sampler carrier. Does not widen default model/binding admission.

metadata.description: Typed request hint, never copied into reported response metadata.

service_tier.description: Request hint; the reported effective tier may differ. Endpoint context admission remains independent.

logprobs.description: Return token probabilities when true; null/false are inactive controls.

top_logprobs.description: A non-null integer requires logprobs:true; null normalizes to absent.

ChatRequest.description: Envelope subset, not an arbitrary upstream parameter bag. Known fields follow the codec; stop and top_k have codec carriers but unchanged default binding admission remains narrower. SDK extra_body is flattened before HTTP transmission, not accepted as a wire bag. Known unowned hosted-search, execution and native RPC controls reject; other unknown fields are ignored by name. Active functions, function_call, web_search_options and store:true reject. Return reasoning_details unchanged for opaque replay. Named projection may omit container boundaries, not call/result identity.

ChatTool.description: Envelope subset, not a binding activation promise. Chat has no pinned custom-call SSE delta carrier. Qualified or active orchestration contexts remain rejected.

ResponsesReasoningSummary.description: Standard summary control. Boolean false is not a disabled carrier; typed Disabled remains unrepresentable, not omission or null.

ResponsesLeafTool.description: Envelope subset. Parameters, format, strict defaults and dispatch combinations require owning codec/profile checks.

ResponsesToolNamespace.description: Ordered non-nested group. Same-kind names are unique within a group; different groups may reuse names. Total definitions plus groups share the tool budget. Calls carry namespace; results refer to call_id.

safety_identifier.description: Independent opaque safety attribution. On single-carrier cross-protocol targets it takes priority over user; explicit null blocks fallback. Target bounds still apply; no normalization or credential/conversation-derived value.

user.description: Legacy attribution and cache-bucketing field, independent of safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key. Native OpenAI paths preserve it. Cross-protocol attribution fallback does not preserve legacy cache bucketing; its loss is recorded separately.

store.description: Omitted, null or true retains this response in gateway TTL memory. Explicit false opts out. Upstream storage stays disabled.

previous_response_id.description: Gateway-owned predecessor. Only history is inherited; current instructions, tools and controls replace top-level settings.

conversation.description: Provider-held conversations and Conversations API are not supported.

prompt_cache_key.description: Cache-grouping intent, separate from conversation identity. Null is not filled from conversation context; cache reports remain upstream facts.

input.description: Ordered input. System/developer instructions are text-only; media-bearing instructions reject at decoding independently of target capabilities.

tools.description: Envelope subset. Namespace choice uses auto/required/none. Schema defaults, dispatch and target admission are checked by the codec.

reasoning.description: Other reasoning controls and conflicting aliases are checked by the owning codec and selected target.

enable_thinking.description: Explicit current-turn activation; target capability and exact carrier are checked independently. Does not invent qualitative effort or a token budget.

max_output_tokens.description: Client-owned output cap. Selected targets may reject explicit caps; local limits alone do not bound upstream charges.

ResponsesRequest.description: Full-history or gateway-managed synchronous profile. Storage defaults to true in bounded TTL memory with no durability; explicit store:false opts out. Only final body handoff publishes a stored reference; cancellation and late errors do not create a readable snapshot. Capacity exhaustion returns history_capacity_exceeded before publication or aborts an already started stream. Selected media and replay still require public/target admission. No arbitrary upstream selection or private attachment. Codecs define exact admission.

MessagesGeneration.description: Anthropic-shaped JSON or SSE under the public model label. Tool calls and reasoning use client block carriers. Completion waits for validated EOF; late failures never become a successful message_stop.

MessagesError.description: Sanitized Messages handler error. Exhausted quota maps to 402; upstream overload maps to 529. All legal remaining targets cooling/probing returns 503 upstream_unavailable. Ingress auth and router method errors use the shared OpenAI envelope.

Retry-After.description: Optional bounded upstream or local recovery delay in seconds; not a guarantee of recovery.

Generation.description: JSON or incremental SSE under the public model label. Codecs define typed output and named losses. HTTP 200 is not semantic success: classified errors may use failure frames, and late failures may abort the body. No fabricated successful terminal.

Error.description: Sanitized OpenAI error. Ingress authentication uses this envelope on every route; 401 includes WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. All legal remaining targets cooling/probing returns 503 upstream_unavailable. No upstream bodies, origins or credentials are echoed.

Retry-After.description: Optional bounded upstream or local recovery delay in seconds; not a guarantee of recovery.
